name: control_moved
description: A control the app moved from the old Control Center list (`docs/control_center_move.md`): one light entry with a custom name, a custom symbol and a tint, on the watch whose owner id is WATCH-1234. It is exactly what `ControlCenterHandover.document` writes, which `ControlCenterHandoverTests` checks against this file: the id is the name-based UUID of `WATCH-1234/light.kitchen`, there are no shapes, the title is a literal of the saved name, the state reads the light, one symbol for both sides, and the tap is `toggleEntity`. `legacyControlEntityId` names the old list entry, which is how the watch's old Toggle tile finds this document. Otherwise it resolves like any control: the light is on, so the toggle reads on.
